citation: Kim et al. (2019), Engineering of an oleaginous bacterium for the production of fatty acids and fuels, Nature Chemical Biology 15:721–729, DOI 10.1038/s41589-019-0295-5
claim_text: Bounded reconstruction target: reported free-fatty-acid fed-batch production result of 50.2 g/L by engineered Rhodococcus opacus.

dependencies.notes: Primary publication explicitly reports 50.2 g/L FFA.
Publisher SI includes strain/plasmid tables, replicate summaries, methods notes and additional fermentation figures.
Nature exposes Supplementary Dataset 1, described as raw data of fed-batch fermentations. Exact byte-level acquisition/hash is still pending.

Nature exposes Supplementary Dataset 2 containing metabolic reactions for genome-scale modeling. This is not required for the bounded 50.2 g/L titer claim but is relevant to later model-provenance analysis.

The 50.2 g/L run is reported for ROP1_34. SI identifies pROP1_34 as expressing R. opacus TAG lipase LPD05381 with Burkholderia cepacia lipase-specific foldase under Pace; manuscript states the FFA producer also carries acyl-CoA synthetase deletions and three-lipase engineering context.
SI documents five independent ROP1_34 fed-batch cultures with FFA titers 50.2, 47.2, 46.7, 49.2, 50.1 g/L, plus culture-level yield/productivity values.

The next audit step is to determine whether the public package preserves the measurement/calculation path from analytical observations to each reported FFA concentration, rather than only the processed fed-batch time series.

findings.evidence: The article abstract and SI both identify the 50.2 g/L FFA result; SI associates it with an ROP1_34 fed-batch run.
findings.interpretation: The bounded claim and producing run are identifiable.

findings.evidence: Public Supplementary Dataset 1 is explicitly labeled raw fed-batch data, but byte-level inspection and the underlying analytical derivation of FFA concentration remain pending.
findings.interpretation: The evidence package is stronger than the podophyllotoxin case, but end-to-end dependency closure is not yet established.

findings.evidence: Publisher artifacts are available, but no local immutable byte hashes have yet been recorded for the XLSX datasets.
findings.interpretation: Source-state integrity cannot yet be asserted by this project.

findings.evidence: The 50.2 g/L value and multiple independent replicate summaries are public; independent recomputation from the released source dataset has not yet been completed.
findings.interpretation: Do not label the headline claim VERIFIED until the dataset is acquired and replayed.
